text:
marco: Quick sync  VoltChip asked for a joint benchmark we can publish on the marketplace tile + a short co-announcement. They're pushing for perf/W to be the headline.

rebecca: We should be explicit about test conditions. My baseline checklist:
- model: redwood-10b (fp16)
- context: 512 tokens
- steady-state run: 10 minutes after warmup
- KV-cache warm: yes (full prefix warm)
- measurement: average tokens/s and average system power (wall)

sam: From infra side, we'll need the kernel patch merged to get stable perf/W. I have a draft patch that does speculative prefetch + tighter tensor layouts. Expect ~7% perf/W uplift in our lab.

sam: I'll post the patch link and a reproducible smoke command later today. Ops will run a staging sweep on Rack-B.

sam: ```
# reproduction
./bench_runner --model=redwood-10b --seq=512 --duration=600 \\
  --collect=tps,power,latency --target=voltchip-rack-B \\
  --kernel=spec-prefetch-v2 --warmup=120
```

voltchip-eng: We'll schedule an engineer to join the Tuesday 11am PT call. Need the exact artifact we want to publish (CSV + chart + config) so we can sign off on figures.

rebecca: Publishing artifacts must include: raw CSV, config.yaml, kernel commit hash, and a 3-bullet "how we tested" blurb. Also include error bars (stddev) across 3 runs.

marco: Legal & marketing: legal review for co-announcement may take 48-72h. Marketing needs final numbers + approved VoltChip logo/assets by Wed EOD to hit next-week marketplace cadence. ops-bot, open legal ticket?

ops-bot: Created ticket LEGAL-517. ETA 72h. Calendar invite sent for Tue 11am PT cross-org call.

rebecca: Proposed acceptance thresholds (must meet or exceed):
- sustained tokens/s >= 10k per rack
- perf/W >= 12 tokens/s/W for redwood-10b
- p99 <= 280ms @512
If any metric misses but trend shows kernel uplift, we can consider a conditional blurb that mentions upcoming kernel release.

marco: I prefer hard thresholds for the marketplace tile. Conditional statements ok for blog/press but tile should show conservative, verified numbers.

sam: Agree. I'll run 3x sweeps tomorrow morning and paste summary results here. If we hit the perf/W target, we cut the artifact package and share with VoltChip for asset approvals.

voltchip-eng: Also need a small note about cooling configuration (CRAC setpoint and airflow) to avoid confusion. We'll provide our rack spec template.

marco: Great. Action items:
- sam: run sweeps + post CSVs (due: tomorrow 2pm PT)
- rebecca: draft "how we tested" blurb + acceptance criteria doc (due: Mon 10am PT)
- voltchip-eng: supply rack spec + 16:9 hero image (due: Mon EOD)
- ops-bot: legal ticket + call invite (done)

rebecca: I'll also prepare short copy for the marketplace tile: one sentence summary, 2 stat bullets, link to full artifacts. Will not publish until legal signoff.

marco: Thanks all. If anything slips, ping here. We'll keep the Tuesday slot for the cross-org smoke. :white_check_mark:
